posts.text: Just started reading Dr. Shoshan Haran’s gripping book ``Mission in Captivity.’’ bit.ly/4vtCmy1 It will make a great play one day. It’s the story of how Hamas gunmen on October 7, 2023, killed her husband, sister, and brother-in-law in Kibbutz Be’eri. Then they kidnapped Haran into Gaza with her daughter, two grandchildren, sister in-law and niece. For 50 days, ten people -- six hostages and four captors -- lived together in a tiny, sealed room. Oh my, what they learned about each other.
